test_distributed_deterministic_sampler: test DistributedDeterministicSampler to verify it produces sequential indices matching range(N) for a given rank and world size
test_distributed_random_sampler_shuffle: test DistributedRandomSampler shuffle method to verify different indices are generated each epoch using a seed parameter
test_distributed_random_sampler_weighted: test DistributedRandomSampler with custom weights to verify indices are drawn proportionally according to weight distribution
test_embed_shuffle_sampler: test embed_shuffle utility to verify it produces identical shuffled results as calling shuffle on DistributedRandomSampler manually
test_iterate_in_subprocess_sampler: test iterate_in_subprocess with embed_shuffle to verify subprocess iteration produces identical results to main process iteration
